title: Book with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Book spine -->
  <rect x='20' y='22' width='10' height='60' rx='3' fill='#7B3F00'/>
  <!-- Book cover -->
  <rect x='28' y='20' width='52' height='64' rx='5' fill='#E63946'/>
  <!-- Book pages (right side block) -->
  <rect x='72' y='24' width='8' height='56' rx='2' fill='#FFF4E6'/>
  <!-- Page lines -->
  <line x1='74' y1='34' x2='78' y2='34' stroke='#D9C5A8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='74' y1='42' x2='78' y2='42' stroke='#D9C5A8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='74' y1='50' x2='78' y2='50' stroke='#D9C5A8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='74' y1='58' x2='78' y2='58' stroke='#D9C5A8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Inner page spread (open book look) -->
  <rect x='33' y='24' width='37' height='56' rx='3' fill='#FFFBF0'/>
  <!-- Bookmark ribbon -->
  <path d='M50 20 L50 10 L56 14 L50 18' fill='#FFB703'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='44' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#1D3557'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='44' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#1D3557'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='42' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='42' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M42 57 Q51.5 67 61 57' stroke='#1D3557' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='54' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FFB4A2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='54' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FFB4A2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Cover highlight -->
  <path d='M30 24 Q55 22 78 24' stroke='#FF6B6B' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Pages edge highlight -->
  <rect x='72' y='24' width='2' height='56' rx='1' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
